scope: schema/design checks with synthetic temporary data; no application integration or user-data migration
checks: connection pragmas, version and transactional schema migration
foreign keys, ordering, required keys and JSON root types
legacy unscoped history and missing agent are preserved
archive restoration preserves records and deterministic remote-chat routing order
message plus usage acceptance is all-or-nothing
unknown usage remains NULL; explicit zero and cumulative snapshots survive
stored integers remain readable under the JavaScript Number contract
call IDs are unique within a message, not across independent messages
image count, per-image bytes and aggregate bytes are enforced
memory provenance and global business keys reject NULL loopholes
recording selection and rule injection preserve array order independently of clocks
repository component ownership and mapping uniqueness
knowledge snapshots require both authority and root; separate identities do not merge
artifact readiness and inbox deduplication have explicit integrity checks
late updates cannot overwrite a newer or terminal message
recovery records interruption without replaying work
deleting a conversation removes owned content and preserves independent records
import manifests prevent a changed source from silently being reimported
WAL supports a reader while another connection holds a bounded write lock
backup is a complete snapshot; external-file manifest detects missing or changed files
future database versions are refused and integrity checks cover both storage and relations
